name: Burlington Country Club
architects: Donald Ross (1924); restored by Dr. Michael Hurdzan (1998) (GolfPass; unverified)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project VT_Statewide_A23 (tile USGS_1M_18_x64y493_VT_Statewide_A23, published 2026-03-31), fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (release data-burlington_cc) and cut to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; EPSG:26918 (NAD83 / UTM 18N), NAVD88 m

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar VT_Statewide_A23 (workunit VT_Statewide_2_A23), tiles N2177E4445 and N2191E4445, flown 21 April 2023 (GPS times; leaf-off); class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project delivers only classes 1, 2, 7, 18); NAD83(2011) / Vermont (EPSG:6589, m), NAVD88 (GEOID18) m; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (release data-burlington_cc), each tile clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2023 USGS Vermont lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 158485) bbox 824 x 1,607 m in UTM 18N + ~120 m scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (228 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (220 m each side; the 2,048 m limit)

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard page (golfpass.com/courses/28945-burlington-country-club/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-30: per-hole yards for Black, Gold, Grey, Green, Aqua and Blue, every row adds up to its total; men's ratings/slopes from 18Birdies (they agree with GolfPass except Grey 128 and Aqua, which GolfPass lists only for women). Stroke indexes from 18Birdies, which agree with the OSM hole lines; GolfPass and GolfingRecord give other indexes (open item). Black per hole also on 18Birdies and OpenGolfAPI (same). GolfingRecord's Blue 2 (368) is a typo (its Blue total is then 4,899 against 4,799 everywhere else). Unverified third-party card; the club's site was not reachable.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2023 Vermont statewide lidar, VT_Statewide_A23)
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-30 (overnight; the developer asleep, calls logged in docs/courses/burlington_cc.md): tee sets Black (the tips) and Blue (developer's overnight rule: the back set and Blue; here Blue is the shortest set, 4,799 yd), default Blue. Standing defaults: every penalty area red, the OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar. Wind 1-10 mph: inland New England is 1-9; one more for the hilltop above Lake Champlain (course chat's call).
tee_shot_margin_note: course chat 2026-10-30: the game's tee-shot test found a 36.7 m crown 31 m out on 16 Black that s06b's own check passed by centimetres; 2 m extra vertical clearance lets s06b drop it (1 m was not enough) (logged in the report)
